title: Efficacy of Balanced Torsional Phacoemulsification Tip for Cataract Surgery

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License'); not CC BY, record kept private

indication: Senile cataract with similar grades across groups (LOCS III score, Table 1); complicated, traumatic, mature-Morgagnian and presenile cataracts and previous intraocular surgery with another eye disease excluded

groups.description: Group 1: torsional phacoemulsification (Centurion, gravity-fed infusion, Ozil IP) with the conventional 0.9-mm 30° mini-flared 12° bent Ozil tip; topical anesthesia, 2.2-mm main and side-port incisions, quick chop or divide and conquer, hydrophobic acrylic IOL in the bag; topical antibiotic and corticosteroid 4 times daily for 1 month
Group 2: same procedure with the Intrepid Balanced tip (0.9-mm mini-flared 45°, double-bent design), the innovative tip under evaluation
Group 3: same procedure with the conventional 0.9-mm 45° mini-flared 22° bent Kelman tip

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 3 row 'CCT preoperative', column Ozil; same value in Table 1); Canon TX-20P non-contact tonometer and pachymeter
series.notes: Table 3 rows CCT preoperative, 1 week (7 days/30.4375), 1 month; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 3 row 'CCT preoperative', column Balanced; same value in Table 1); Canon TX-20P non-contact tonometer and pachymeter
series.notes: Table 3 rows CCT preoperative, 1 week (7 days/30.4375), 1 month; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 3 row 'CCT preoperative', column Kelman; same value in Table 1); Canon TX-20P non-contact tonometer and pachymeter
series.notes: Table 3 rows CCT preoperative, 1 week (7 days/30.4375), 1 month; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

Duplicate of the Table 3 preoperative row, which is cited together with the follow-ups

exclusions.what: Table 2 (intraoperative ultrasound time, CDE, power, fluid volume, aspiration and operation time)

notes: Retrospective review of 150 eyes of 150 patients (of 200 records); the tip was assigned by availability in the operating room, not randomized.

Role: the Intrepid Balanced tip is the innovative device evaluated against the conventional Ozil and Kelman tips (Introduction, Conclusion), so balanced-tip is treated and the two conventional tips are control.
Method: CCT was measured with the Canon TX-20P non-contact tonometer and pachymeter, which is not ultrasound, AS-OCT, Scheimpflug, specular or confocal; recorded as 'other'.
Postoperative CCT was measured at 1 week and 1 month (Methods); no day-1 CCT.
